title: libghostty: ghostty_surface_free deadlocks the app thread when the surface's reader is blocked pushing into the app mailbox
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/discussions/14234
Originally posted by **umputun** September 14, 2026 ### Issue Description Freeing a surface can deadlock the app thread forever. `Surface.deinit` joins the io thread on the calling (app) thread, the io thread joins its reader thread, and the reader can be blocked in a `.forever` push into the app mailbox, a queue only the app thread drains. Once the app thread is inside the join nothing drains the queue, so the reader never returns, the io thread never returns, and `ghostty_surface_free` never returns. Every other surface whose reader then posts a surface message parks in the same push. The wait chain at 683d8db (unchanged on d5eba8d16): - app thread: `ghostty_surface_free` -> `Surface.deinit` -> `self.io_thr.join()` (https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/blob/683d8db643b95cf229bfb5fe9fab9ae677920343/src/Surface.zig#L818) - io thread: `termio.Thread.threadMain` -> `Exec.threadExit` -> `exec.read_thread.join()` (https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/blob/683d8db643b95cf229bfb5fe9fab9ae677920343/src/termio/Exec.zig#L229) - io-reader (parse stage): `ReadThread.threadMainPosix` -> `Termio.processOutput` -> a stream handler action -> `surfaceMessageWriter` (https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/blob/683d8db643b95cf229bfb5fe9fab9ae677920343/src/termio/stream_handler.zig#L130-L140) -> `apprt.surface.Mailbox.push` -> `App.Mailbox.push` -> `BlockingQueue.push` waiting on `cond_not_full` (https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/blob/683d8db643b95cf229bfb5fe9fab9ae677920343/src/datastruct/blocking_queue.zig#L115) - the queue is `BlockingQueue(Message, 64)` (https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/blob/683d8db643b95cf229bfb5fe9fab9ae677920343/src/App.zig#L611) and its only consumer is `App.drainMailbox` from `App.tick` (https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/blob/683d8db643b95cf229bfb5fe9fab9ae677920343/src/App.zig#L265), on the app thread In the original user's sample the blocked reader came through a CSI action (`Stream.csiDispatchFinal` -> `StreamHandler.vt` -> `Mailbox.push`) and four other surfaces' readers were parked in the same push from `StreamHandler.windowTitle`. In my reproductions the closing surface's reader is in `windowTitle` -> `Mailbox.push`. A second shape of the same hang, seen in every single-surface run: the reader stall fills the 4-slot gather ring, the gather stage stops reading the pty, and `Exec.threadExit` never reaches the quit-pipe write because `Subprocess.stop` -> `killPid` (https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/blob/683d8db643b95cf229bfb5fe9fab9ae677920343/src/termio/Exec.zig#L1176-L1214) loops on `killpg` / `waitpid(WNOHANG)` / 10 ms sleep with no bound. `ps` shows the child's `login` wrapper in exit state with its own child a zombie or also exiting, and `waitpid` never returns it. I read that as the wrapper's exit blocking on tty output drain; the sample proves the loop and the full ring, not the kernel wait. This is an embedding report: libghostty built from 683d8db, embedded in agterm (macOS, SwiftUI; https://github.com/umputun/agterm). A user hit it with 10 surfaces open (https://github.com/umputun/agterm/issues/606), and it reproduces on demand with the recipe below, in the shipped agterm 0.28.0 and in a Debug build using the same pinned libghostty. Ghostty.app 1.3.1 and the tip build (d5eba8d16) did not hang when the spamming command exited on its own and the surface closed on child exit; closing a still-producing Ghostty.app surface was not tested. ### Expected Behavior `ghostty_surface_free` returns. A surface whose program is producing output at the moment of the close is torn down like any other; at worst its pending output is dropped. ### Actual Behavior `ghostty_surface_free` blocks forever in `pthread_join`. The app thread is gone, so every surface in the process stops updating and the process has to be killed with SIGKILL. In the io-join shape the closed surface's child was already reaped; in the kill-loop shape its `login` wrapper is stuck in exit with a zombie or exiting child. ### Reproduction Steps Tested host: agterm 0.28.0 (and a Debug build using the same pinned libghostty) on macOS 26.6.2, libghostty 683d8db. The close is agterm's `agtermctl session close`, which calls `ghostty_surface_free` on the app thread. 1. Create a surface and run in it (zsh): `while :; do printf '\e]0;t%s\a' $RANDOM; done` 2. Close that surface from the app thread. 3. The close never returns. `sample ` shows the app thread in `Surface.deinit` -> `pthread_join`, the surface's `io` thread in the `killPid` loop (single surface) or in `pthread_join` on its reader (eight spamming surfaces, one closed), and its `io-reader` in `apprt.surface.Mailbox.push` -> `__ulock_wait2`. Control runs: on the 0.28.0 instance, with the spamming surface open and no close, the app thread answered 10 control requests over 10 seconds; on the Debug instance, closing one idle surface with eight idle surfaces open took 67 ms. Raw `sample` outputs (Zig frames stripped) and the symbolication table resolving them against `libghostty-internal.a`: https://gist.github.com/umputun/9ffd6da3e3b93d649ae9c109c59823d4 ### Ghostty Logs ``` 2026-09-14 13:21:17.565 E agterm[69525:1d9e6a0] [com.mitchellh.ghostty:default] io_exec: shell could not be detected, no automatic shell integration will be injected ``` That is the only `com.mitchellh.ghostty` line during the 0.28.0 run; nothing is logged at the hang. ### Ghostty Version ``` libghostty from ghostty-org/ghostty 683d8db643b95cf229bfb5fe9fab9ae677920343 (2026-08-25) zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Demit-xcframework=true -Dxcframework-target=native, zig 0.16.0 embedded in agterm 0.28.0 (https://github.com/umputun/agterm) the cited code is unchanged on main at d5eba8d16 (Ghostty 1.3.2-main-+d5eba8d16) ``` ### OS Version Information macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), Apple Silicon ### Minimal Ghostty Configuration The config agterm passes to libghostty in the reproduction (`theme = agterm` is a theme file agterm bundles; the other two are unrelated to the hang): ```ini theme = agterm mouse-scroll-multiplier = 3 right-click-action = paste ``` ### Additional Relevant Configuration Downstream report with the user's samples: https://github.com/umputun/agterm/issues/606 AI usage disclosure: Claude Code and Codex, driven by me, did the offset symbolication (instruction-sequence matching against `libghostty-internal.a`), ran the reproductions and wrote the first draft of this text. I reviewed the cited code paths and edited the text. ### I acknowledge that: - [x] I have reviewed the FAQ and confirm that my issue is NOT among them. - [x] I have searched the Ghostty documentation and confirm there doesn't exist a configuration option that solves my issue. - [x] I have searched the Ghostty repository (both open and closed Discussions and Issues) and confirm this is not a duplicate of an existing issue or discussion. - [x] I have checked the "Preview" tab on all text fields to ensure that everything looks right, and have wrapped all configuration and code in code blocks with a group of three backticks (` ``` `) on separate lines.
